description: This file defines a class 'MeetingsJjwg_MapsLogicHook' which acts as a logic hook handler for meeting geocode updates within the SuiteCRM project. It initializes the jjwg_Maps module info and updates geocode information after meetings are saved, based on configuration settings.

classes.name: MeetingsJjwg_MapsLogicHook
classes.description: Handles logic hook events to update geocode information related to meetings using the jjwg_Maps module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the logic hook object and retrieves the 'jjwg_Maps' module information.

methods.name: updateMeetingGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode info for a meeting bean if the logic hooks are enabled in the settings.
